name: exercise_lifecycle

states.label: Closed
states.description: Led to what it was for; each element it led to is derived-from it.

states.label: Abandoned
states.description: Dropped without leading anywhere; the reason is a comment on it.

transitions.name: close
transitions.description: The exercise has led to what it was for.

transitions.name: abandon
transitions.description: Drop the exercise; say why in a comment.

transitions.name: revive
transitions.description: Take a dropped exercise up again.

description: An exercise is open while it explores; it is closed once it has led to the elements it was for, or abandoned when it is dropped. Closed and abandoned exercises leave the session agenda; either can be reopened.
